title: Full Strength - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Full Strength in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Lumiere Act III merchant near the Gardens, 53,200 Chroma

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Full Strength is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases damage at full Health.

sections.title: How to Get Full Strength
sections.content: Location: Lumiere Act III merchant near the Gardens, 53,200 Chroma.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
